item: row 402: database copies and corpus segments are head-only only on record evidence (R823, R826)
key_paths: src/safety/crypto_erase.py; src/database/at_rest_state.py; src/backup/merge.py; src/database/rebuild.py; tests/test_erase_copies_r823.py; tests/test_segment_record_r826.py
summary: A database copy beside a store or a corpus segment is erased by its first page and said destroyed only with a non-SQLite header AND the record entry its writer bound to that very file; otherwise page 1 at once then a full R797 rewrite, said overwritten by count and kind, never named. The corpus folder is swept no-follow through its handle; foreign items left and counted. record_segment/forget_segment ready for stage 2. Kept-handle I/O is Windows-safe (no pread/pwrite).
